verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of Homebrew verifying downloaded bottles, casks or sources against checksums, signatures or attestations. Tap trust (installing a fully qualified item to trust only that item) controls which repositories are trusted, not artifact integrity, and `brew audit` checks formula definitions, so both are adjacent features rather than download verification. The Trail of Bits audit comment gives no detail on integrity checks.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can trust that fetched packages are verified against checksums, signatures, or attestations before they run
